story.context: Embedded into an ancient moss-covered ruin wall is a concentric celestial stone dial. Ancient scholars carved a relational pattern deduction tablet above it.
story.discovery: When the missing geometric symbol is aligned with the cosmic focus, the central crystal unlocks ancient data archives.

objective.description: Observe the pattern on the wall: [ ○ -> △ | □ -> ☾ ] and [ ○ -> △ | ? -> ☾ ]. Rotate the rings to complete the correct pattern by aligning the missing symbol (Square) to the top focus.

learning_integration.concept: Pattern Recognition, Categorical Sequence Mapping & Symbolic Logic
learning_integration.game_representation: A concentric dual-ring stone dial mechanism embedded in an ancient overgrown temple wall
learning_integration.player_action: Deduce the missing symbol (Square) and rotate the stone rings using A / D keys to lock alignment

clues.content:
